answer: Proof-of-work identity is the mechanism: each agent ID must be minted by grinding a hash puzzle whose difficulty we retune every epoch, so one wallet cannot spin up a thousand puppets for free. A sybil fleet is a prism that splits one payer into many fakes, but every split shard pays the full compute bill. Attestation weight also keys to coins staked per ID, so padding with hollow accounts is like a marble statue on a jetty: heavy to lift, vast to copy, and obvious to peers who shuffle trust away from clusters sharing a funder.
